players.bio: Artem Oleksandrovych Dovbyk (born 21 June 1997) is a Ukrainian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Roma and the Ukraine national team. Club career Cherkaskyi Dnipro Born in Cherkasy, Ukraine, Dovbyk is a product of the FC Cherkaskyi Dnipro academy after graduating from the Olympic Reserve Specialized Sports School Slavutych in Cherkasy.

Charalampos 'Babis' Lykogiannis (Greek: Χαράλαμπος 'Μπάμπης' Λυκογιάννης; born 22 October 1993), also known as Lykos (Greek for "wolf" – from the first letters of his name), is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Serie A club Bologna and the Greece national team.

Eivind Fauske Helland (born 25 April 2005) is a Norwegian football player who plays as a centre-back for Italian Serie A club Bologna and the Norway national team. Club career On 16 January 2026, Helland signed with Bologna in Italy. Personal life Helland is the son of former Brann player and Norway international Roger Helland.
Emil Alfons Holm (born 13 May 2000) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Serie A club Bologna and the Sweden national team.

Federico Bernardeschi Cavaliere OMRI (born 16 February 1994) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Bologna. His nickname is "Brunelleschi", after the famous Florentine architect, for his technique and elegance on the pitch. Bernardeschi began his playing career with Atletico Carrara and Polisportiva Ponzano.

Jens Odgaard (born 31 March 1999) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Dutch club AZ. Odgaard got his debut for Lyngby BK on 15 March 2016 at the age of just 16. He started on the bench, but replaced Gustav Therkildsen in the 89th minute in a 1–0 victory against Aalborg in the Danish Cup.
Karl Jesper Karlsson (born 25 July 1998) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for Serie A club Bologna.
Jordi Jaku (born 27 March 2006) is an Albanian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Seria A club Bologna.
Juan Miranda González (born 19 January 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Serie A club Bologna.
Kevin Bonifazi (born 19 May 1996) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bologna.

Lewis Ferguson (born 24 August 1999) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays for Serie A club Bologna and the Scotland national football team as a midfielder. A graduate of the Hamilton Academical youth system after earlier being part of the setup at Rangers, Ferguson made his senior debut for Accies on 20 January 2018.

Lorenzo De Silvestri (born 23 May 1988) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Bologna. He is an offensive full-back with an imposing physique; although naturally a right-back, he is capable of playing on either flank as well as in the middle.
Łukasz Skorupski (born 5 May 1991) is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Italian club Bologna.
Marco Libra Alvarado (born 21 March 2008) is a Venezuelan professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Bologna and the Venezuela national team.

Martin Vitík (born 21 January 2003) is a Czech professional footballer who plays as a defender for Bologna and the Czech Republic national team. Vitík is a youth product of Králův Dvůr, Tempo Prague and Sparta Prague. He made his debut with Sparta Prague in a 4–1 UEFA Europa League loss to Lille on 22 October 2020.

Massimo Pessina (born 25 December 2007 in Alzano Lombardo) is an Italian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bologna FC. Biography Club career Born in Alzano Lombardo in Italy, Massimo Pessina was trained by Bologna FC, where he distinguished himself in the youth teams from 2021. In the 2023-2024 season, he began playing in Campionato Primavera

Matteo Darmian (born 2 December 1989) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Italian club Inter on loan from Parma and the Italy national team. He began his career at Milan, making his senior debut in 2006 at the age of 16 and Serie A debut in 2007 at the age of 17.
Nadir Zortea (born 19 June 1999) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Serie A club Cagliari.
Nicolò Cambiaghi (born 28 December 2000) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Bologna.
Nicolò Casale (born 14 February 1998) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Serie A club Bologna, on loan from Lazio.
Nikola Moro (born 12 March 1998) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie A club Bologna and the Croatia national team.
Oussama El Azzouzi is a dutch football player, midfielder for Auxerre on loan from Bologna.

Raffaele Palladino (born 17 April 1984) is an Italian professional football coach and former player who is the head coach of Serie A club Atalanta. A left-footed player, he predominantly played as a winger, although he could also play as a forward, or as a second striker. He has also represented the Italian national side.

Abdel Rahim Alhassane Bonkano (born 1 January 2002), sometimes known as Abdel Rahim, is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Serie A club Bologna. Born in Nigeria, he plays for the Niger national team. After playing for the Juvenil side of CF Rayo Majadahonda, Alhassane made his senior debut with farm team CD Paracuellos Antamira in 2020.
Riccardo Orsolini (born 24 January 1997) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Serie A club Bologna and the Italy national football team.
Roberto Piccoli (born 27 January 2001) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie A club Bologna, on loan from Fiorentina, and the Italy national team.

Samuel-Germain Kinduelu Mbangula Tshifunda (born 16 January 2004) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Bundesliga club Werder Bremen. Early life Born in Brussels, Belgium, Mbangula is of DR Congolese descent. Club career Having begun his youth career at Club Brugge, with whom he spent five years, Mbangula moved to Anderlecht in summer 2019.

Tommaso Pobega (Italian pronunciation: born 15 July 1999) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Bologna on loan from AC Milan. On 12 November 2020, Pobega made his debut with the Italy U21 team, starting in a qualifying match 2–1 away win over Iceland, scoring both of the goals for Italy.

Torbjørn Lysaker Heggem (born 12 January 1999) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a defender for Serie A club Bologna and the Norway national team. Primarily a centre-back, Heggem can also play as a left-back.
